lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَانٍ is in the derivative form: فانىِ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/ن/ى f–n–y to perish, to expire, to pass away, to come to an end; large, open courtyard. Of this root, فانٍ fānin, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
فانىِ fānı [act. part.] one that perishes, subject to death, mortal, perishable

(55:26) كُلُّ‏ ‏مَنْ‏ ‏عَلَيْهَا‏ ‏فَانٍ‏ everything on it [the Earth] will perish.
